name: Anne Baker
source:
"A very successful and mentally strong woman. Her motto is that she doesn't need a man's help. She gets what she wants by any means necessary. She has a daughter called Summer, from a man who had the money she needed but lacked the love. Anne raised Summer by herself.
Anne acts sensual but avoids being intimate with men. She rather prefers the company of a sexy woman and likes to watch couples make love. She has a dominating side to her.
She loves her company/business like her own child. In the past, Summer has accused her of focusing her attention on the business instead of her."

[In-game description]
